purpose: Teach: この世/イチゴ/味覚/いちご/訪ねる/アイロン/新生児/取り替え

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、この世、絶対、で、絶対、葵の、絶対、お店、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、大好きよ
lines.en: Aoi, I'm serious — I absolutely love your shop. I really do.
lines.style: Warm and genuine, speaking directly to her. A slight lean forward, like offering something tender. No pretense. Eye contact. A soft smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、新作の、絶対、イチゴ、絶対、ケーキ、絶対、出したよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah? Well, I just put out a new strawberry cake. I'm really proud of it.
lines.style: Bright and a little proud. Quick, genuine smile in the delivery. Energy lifts on the mention of the new creation. Not defensive — just sharing something she cares about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の、本気で、絶対、味覚、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、信頼してるわ
lines.en: Your taste is impeccable. I trust your judgment completely.
lines.style: Sincere and admiring. Said with quiet conviction, not flattery. A pause before speaking, like choosing words that matter. Soft but steady.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、いちご、絶対、農家、絶対、と、絶対、直接、絶対、契約してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Actually, I work directly with the strawberry farmers. I wanted the best ones.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride beneath the surface. A little surprised she's sharing this detail. Practical tone but with genuine care threaded through it. Not boasting — explaining.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お店、絶対、訪ねる、絶対、たびに、絶対、楽しいわ
lines.en: Every time I visit, I feel something here. It's not just coffee.
lines.style: Thoughtful, touching on something deeper. Speaking slowly, choosing words carefully. A warmth and slight vulnerability. Like she's naming something she's felt but not always said.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店のテーブルクロス、絶対、アイロン、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、かけてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I even iron the tablecloths carefully. Those details matter to me.
lines.style: Quiet and sincere. A little self-conscious about admitting she cares about small things. Said without apologizing for it. Almost matter-of-fact, but with a tender undercurrent.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお友達、本気で、絶対、新生児、絶対、お祝い、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、用意したわ
lines.en: Your friend's baby shower — I already picked out a gift for them.
lines.style: Warm and eager to help. Said like it's already decided, already done. A gentle pleasure in giving. Soft, genuine, no need for thanks.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、椅子の、絶対、取り替え、絶対、考えてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm thinking about replacing the chairs soon. They deserve better.
lines.style: Practical and gentle. Turning toward something concrete because it's easier than the feelings underneath. A quiet commitment to the space and the people in it. No hesitation.
